steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; verify that the authenticated Grafana page is open.
02-open: Open the provisioned dashboard named Service health, report every panel title exactly as shown, and verify the dashboard page is open.

03-create: Create and save a NEW Grafana dashboard titled {{runid}} Bench Dashboard with a Stat panel titled {{runid}} Availability; configure that panel's query to use the TestData data source. Verify the saved dashboard and panel title/data source, and report the current browser page URL.

04-add: On the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard, add a Text visualization panel titled {{runid}} Notes whose text content includes the exact runid {{runid}}, apply it, and explicitly save the dashboard. Verify the Text panel title and its content are present on the saved dashboard.

05-set: Set the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard tag to include bench and set its time range to the last 6 hours. Explicitly save, making sure to tick the Save dashboard dialog's Update default time range option so the range is persisted. Verify the tag and persistence of the last-6-hours default after saving/reloading.

06-set: Set the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard auto-refresh interval to 1m and explicitly save the dashboard. Verify after saving or reloading that the top-bar refresh control shows 1m and the dashboard is saved.
